content.user_title: Deploy Your Hybrid App to Vercel
content.value_statement: Hybrid web applications can require separate build steps and deployment settings. This skill explains the documented build flow and required Vercel configuration.
actual_capabilities: Explains the documented build order for the Next.js and Docusaurus applications.
Identifies the command that creates the public documentation directory.
Describes copying generated documentation into the Next.js public directory.
Summarizes the Vercel configuration path for the FastAPI backend.
Lists the environment variable names required by the documented deployment.
limitations: It provides deployment guidance only and does not run builds or deployments.
It does not validate Vercel project settings or environment variable values.
It does not create backend configuration files or application code.
It assumes the project uses the documented Next.js, Docusaurus, and FastAPI layout.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first Vercel deployment
use_cases.description: Review the required build stages and environment variable names before deploying the documented application.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot missing documentation
use_cases.description: Check whether the Docusaurus build output is copied into the expected Next.js public directory.

use_cases.title: Hand off deployment requirements
use_cases.description: Share the backend route configuration and required Vercel settings with an operations teammate.

prompt_templates.title: Review deployment steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the documented build steps for this project in order and state what each step produces.

prompt_templates.title: List Vercel settings
prompt_templates.prompt: List the environment variable names required for this deployment and explain where to configure them in Vercel.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose documentation output
prompt_templates.prompt: The documentation is missing after deployment. Use the documented build flow to identify the checks I should perform.

prompt_templates.title: Create a deployment checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pre-deployment checklist for the documented Next.js, Docusaurus, and FastAPI application. Separate build, Vercel, and secret configuration checks.

output_examples.input: What happens during the hybrid build?
output: Copy the documentation output into public/docs.

output_examples.input: What should I configure in Vercel?
output_examples.output: Configure the documented environment variable names in the Vercel Dashboard and confirm backend/vercel.json routes API requests to the Python function.

best_practices: Run the documented build sequence locally before deploying.
Store secret values in Vercel environment settings, not source files.
Verify that generated documentation is present in public/docs before the Next.js build.
anti_patterns: Do not commit API keys or authentication secrets to the repository.
Do not skip the documentation build before copying its output.
Do not assume backend route rewrites work without checking the Vercel configuration.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy the application?
faq.answer: No. It documents the deployment pipeline and configuration requirements.

faq.question: Which applications does the build process include?
faq.answer: The documented process includes a Next.js root application and a Docusaurus documentation application.

faq.question: Where is the documentation output placed?
faq.answer: The documented process copies generated files into public/docs.

faq.question: Where are environment variables configured?
faq.answer: Configure them in the Vercel Dashboard for the deployment environment.

faq.question: Does the skill reveal secret values?
faq.answer: No. It lists variable names only and does not access their values.

faq.question: How are API requests handled?
faq.answer: The documented Vercel configuration rewrites /api requests to the Python function.
